popCulture.title: Olympic Games
popCulture.description: Tradition ties the chariot race for Hippodamia to Olympia's founding — Pelops' cursed victory as the mythic seed of the Games.

popCulture.title: Pelops
popCulture.description: Pelops endures as the ivory-shouldered ancestor of the Atreids — the race that won a bride and doomed a dynasty.
